article_context: 用心理学研究说明瞬间判断既有适应价值，也会被快速刺激和偏见操纵；暂停思考可以削弱这种影响。主讲人采用清晰、温和的学术解释语气。

article.title: 阅读三 · 给快速反应按下暂停键
article.background: 用心理学研究说明瞬间判断既有适应价值，也会被快速刺激和偏见操纵；暂停思考可以削弱这种影响。主讲人采用清晰、温和的学术解释语气。

sentences.en: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.
sentences.zh: 科学家发现，虽然我们很容易作出瞬间的过度反应，但如果稍停片刻，想一想自己可能会怎样反应，就能减轻甚至消除这种快速、先天反应带来的负面影响。

segments.text: Scientists have found that although we are prone to snap overreactions, if we take a moment and think about how we are likely to react, we can reduce or even eliminate the negative effects of our quick, hard-wired responses.

sentences.en: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.
sentences.zh: 瞬间判断可以是一种重要的防御机制；当我们判断某个人是否危险时，大脑和身体天生就会在几毫秒内迅速作出反应。

segments.text: Snap decisions can be important defense mechanisms; if we are judging whether someone is dangerous, our brains and bodies are hard-wired to react very quickly, within milliseconds.

sentences.en: But we need more time to assess other factors.
sentences.zh: 但在评估其他因素时，我们需要更多时间。

segments.text: But we need more time to assess other factors.

sentences.en: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，要准确判断一个人是否善于交际，至少需要一分钟，最好有五分钟。

segments.text: To accurately tell whether someone is sociable, studies show, we need at least a minute, preferably five.

sentences.en: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
sentences.zh: 判断神经质或开放性这类复杂人格特征，需要一些时间。

segments.text: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality, like neuroticism or open-mindedness.

sentences.en: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.
sentences.zh: 但对快速刺激作出的瞬间判断，并不只存在于人际领域。

segments.text: But snap decisions in reaction to rapid stimuli aren't exclusive to the interpersonal realm.

sentences.en: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.
sentences.zh: 多伦多大学的心理学家发现，只看几毫秒的快餐标志，就会让我们在随后阅读时速度提高20%，尽管阅读与吃饭几乎毫无关系。

segments.text: Psychologists at the University of Toronto found that viewing a fast-food logo for just a few milliseconds primes us to read 20 percent faster, even though reading has little to do with eating.

sentences.en: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.
sentences.zh: 我们会在无意识中把快餐与速度和急躁联系起来，并把这些冲动带进正在做的其他事情中。

segments.text: We unconsciously associate fast food with speed and impatience and carry those impulses into whatever else we're doing.

sentences.en: Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.
sentences.zh: 接触过快速闪现的快餐图像的受试者，也往往会觉得一段音乐持续得太久。

segments.text: Subjects exposed to fast-food flashes also tend to think a musical piece lasts too long.

sentences.en: Yet we can reverse such influences.
sentences.zh: 不过，我们可以逆转这些影响。

segments.text: Yet we can reverse such influences.

sentences.en: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.
sentences.zh: 如果我们知道，看到一张笑脸时自己更容易对消费品或住房选择反应过度——这也是优秀销售人员和房地产经纪人总在微笑的一个原因——那么购买前就可以停一下再作决定。

segments.text: If we know we will overreact to consumer products or housing options when we see a happy face (one reason good sales representatives and real estate agents are always smiling), we can take a moment before buying.

sentences.en: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases - or hire outside screeners.
sentences.zh: 如果我们知道女性招聘人员更可能拒绝有吸引力的女性求职者，就可以帮助筛选人员认识到自己的偏见，或者干脆聘请外部筛选人员。

segments.text: If we know female job screeners are more likely to reject attractive female applicants, we can help screeners understand their biases - or hire outside screeners.

sentences.en: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.
sentences.zh: 婚姻专家约翰·戈特曼解释说，只有当这种快速反应建立在长期、深入的研究之上时，我们才能可靠地对信息进行迅速的“薄片式”判断。

segments.text: John Gottman, the marriage expert, explains that we quickly "thin slice" information reliably only after we ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study.

sentences.en: When Dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.
sentences.zh: 当戈特曼博士真正想评估一对伴侣能否长久相处时，他会邀请他们到自己的岛上休养地接受更长时间的评估：不是两秒，而是两天。

segments.text: When Dr. Gottman really wants to assess whether a couple will stay together, he invites them to his island retreat for a much longer evaluation: two days, not two seconds.

sentences.en: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们能够通过暂停来抑制先天反应，这一点使我们区别于动物：狗只能偶尔思考未来，而且通常只能想几分钟。

segments.text: Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals: dogs can think about the future only intermittently or for a few minutes.

sentences.en: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.
sentences.zh: 但从历史上看，我们一天中大约有12%的时间会用来思考更长远的事情。

segments.text: But historically we have spent about 12 percent of our days contemplating the longer term.

sentences.en: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.
sentences.zh: 技术或许会改变我们的反应方式，却没有改变我们的本性。

segments.text: Although technology might change the way we react, it hasn't changed our nature.

sentences.en: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
sentences.zh: 我们仍有想象未来的能力，可以超越诱惑，扭转这种越来越追求高速反应的趋势。

segments.text: We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend.
